verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's GitHub README lists 'screenshots' as one of its LLM-ready output formats (firecrawl-gh-9), confirming basic screenshot capture capability, but no documentation details specify full-page vs. selected-area capture options, and a community comment even asks whether screenshots are supported at all, suggesting inconsistent documentation (firecrawl-comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit docs on full-page vs. specific-selector screenshot parameters, and independent hands-on confirmation of the feature working as described.
